atoms.title: The Maracas
atoms.b: Each maraca is made up of a handle and a rounded, hollow end that is filled with small objects, such as rice or sand. When you shake a maraca, you hear a sound.
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='0.5'>instrument-shaker-2</voice> <break time='1000ms'/> Each maraca is made up of a handle and a rounded, hollow end that is filled with small objects, such as rice or sand. When you shake a maraca, you hear a sound.

atoms.b: With a maraca you can play rhythms, but not melodies. It is common to play two maracas at the same time, one in each hand. This allows you to play a more complex rhythm.
